use_when: To show one image or video in a fixed frame, landscape (5:3) or square (1:1)
When the media should fill the frame, cropped to cover
When the frame should be focusable and respond to hover, such as a clickable media tile

dont_use_when.when: For a person's photo or initials.
When the whole image must stay visible, since edges get cropped.

best_practice: Pick the ratio to suit the subject: 5:3 for scenes, 1:1 for objects or portraits
Use the Website size on web and the Mobile size on mobile
Keep the key part of the image away from the edges, because they are cropped
Write alt text that describes the image, or leave it empty if it is purely decorative

variant_intent.state=Default: Lets hover and keyboard focus happen for real (code).
variant_intent.state=Hover: Pins the hover look, for docs and QA (code).
variant_intent.state=Focus: Pins the focus look, for docs and QA (code).

a11y.fact: The container takes keyboard focus (tabIndex defaults to 0).
The image takes its alternative text from the alt prop; an empty alt marks it decorative.
Shows a focus stroke on keyboard focus.
